title: Beautiful perfect party decoration! Also they look great when in full shape !
text: Beautiful perfect party decoration! Also they look great when in full shape !. Loved them. I did inflate one just to see how they looked seeing as I was going to use them for my birthday party in the end due to some unfortunate circumstances I could not use them but I did manage to blow at least one up and see how they looked and they were amazing! The mouth pieces are super convenient! And they look super cute once you inflate them enough! <3 I recommend 100% if you have a kids party or just a party in general they seem to be perfect as decoration <3
